أستئب (form X)
# أَسْتَئِبُّ (ʔastaʔibbu) /ʔas.ta.ʔib.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَأَبَّ (istaʔabba)
# أَسْتَئِبَّ (ʔastaʔibba) /ʔas.ta.ʔib.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَأَبَّ (istaʔabba)
# أَسْتَئِبِّ (ʔastaʔibbi) /ʔas.ta.ʔib.bi/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَأَبَّ (istaʔabba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
